title: Ad-hoc field liaison queue (Feb 2026)
body:
Purpose: lightweight cross-functional intake and short-run handoff tracker for field/inflow asks. Use this when an ask is < 3 people and <= 2 sprints of work. Not for full projects — that's product roadmap.

Notes to self: column "Priority" is relative to current sprint coverage; try to avoid P0 unless customer-facing outage. Use "liaison" to indicate who is maintaining status externally. Keep ETA as business-day estimate.

Sheet layout (columns): ID | Requestor | Team | Short ask | Priority | ETA (EBD) | Liaison | Status | Workaround/Notes | Linked ticket/PR

Rows:
1 | Aaron Lopez | customer-success | Investigate sudden throttle errors for ACME Corp (US-WEST) | P0 | 2026-02-19 | Priya Nair | in_progress | CS posted temporary rate-limit increase; root cause suspected region routing rule mismatch | JIRA:CS-1298, slack:#cs-acme
2 | Jenna Park | eng-platform | Quick config change to allow internal dev tokens to bypass quota (dev-only) | P2 | 2026-02-26 | Evan Morales | needs_context | security ok for dev env, gating PR required | https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-config/pull/214
3 | Mateo Ruiz | solutions-eng | Short demo template: embed + rerank sample for retail partner meetup | P3 | 2026-03-02 | Sofia Kim | queued | copy of demo assets in drive, need small inference endpoint | GDrive:drive/folders/1X-demo
4 | Claire D'Souza | product-ops | One-off billing reconciliation request (Feb invoices) | P1 | 2026-02-22 | Luis Ortega | in_progress | awaiting finance confirmation on credits applied | JIRA:FIN-3302
5 | Omar Nadeem | eng-observability | Add lightweight latency sampling for embed endpoints (1% sample) | P2 | 2026-02-28 | Evan Morales | blocked | needs guardrails for PII sampling, SRE review required | JIRA:OBS-2120
6 | Priya Nair | customer-success | Temporary FAQ for outbound partner emails re: dedicated capacity | P3 | 2026-02-20 | Priya Nair | done | sent to comms; stored in GDrive | GDrive:docs/partner-faq-dedicated
7 | Nina Patel | solutions-eng | 2-page quickstart for private deploy on GCP (edge case: restricted org) | P2 | 2026-03-05 | Luis Ortega | needs_owner | SE volunteered but needs infra time | JIRA:SE-451
8 | Rohan Gupta | eng-infra | Short spike: measure cold-start for a new quant profile (4 runs) | P3 | 2026-02-24 | Evan Morales | in_progress | perf numbers look noisy, will rerun with controlled load | PR:perf/spike-quant-4
9 | Tessa Li | go-to-market | Quick slide update for partner kickoff (1 slide) | P3 | 2026-02-21 | Sofia Kim | done | updated slide deck; asked comms to review | GDrive:slides/partner-kickoff
10 | Mark Benson | legal | Confirm data retention for demo tenants used by sales pilots | P1 | 2026-02-19 | Priya Nair | in_progress | legal asked for export of retention policy and sample logs | JIRA:LEGAL-77

Quick heuristics / SOP: 
- If Status == needs_owner: ping the "liaison" or team lead in slack after 24 business hours.
- For P0/P1 items, put an explicit fallback: who covers if liaison is OOO? Add that to Notes.
- When item transitions to done, update Linked ticket to final closure and add short postmortem if it was P0/P1.

Open questions (TODOs): 
- Do we want a column for "SLA impact" (yes/no) for next iteration? (suggested by SRE)
- Auto-notifications: can we wire an affordable flow from this sheet to slack for P0 items? (low-effort webhook idea)

Recent change log: 
- 2026-02-18: created by Priya Nair during on-call spike to capture ad-hoc asks.
- 2026-02-19: added Mark Benson legal ask; escalated ACME throttle to P0.
- 2026-02-22: updated billing reconciliation status after finance reply.

Comments (freeform):
- "Notes to assignee: timebox any investigation > 4 hours and escalate back to liaison with findings."
- "This sheet is intentionally minimal — if an item grows beyond one sprint, move to product roadmap and notify stakeholders."

Owner contact: priya.nair@redwood.ai (use for quick clarifications)
